I was asked: People say that once a contract is deployed, it can't be changed. So why can some projects still be upgraded?
I usually answer like this: When upgrading, an account with upgrade permissions changes the proxy contract to point to a new logic contract. The address users interact with stays the same, but the underlying logic changes. Many protocols put upgrade permissions under multisig control or governance votes, and add a timelock so the upgrade is announced in advance before taking effect, giving users time to withdraw.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candle you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The price shoots up in one big bullish candle, everyone in the group chat is yelling “Go for it!”, and you panic-buy—only to end up buying at
the very top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a close look at that big bullish candle that got your heart racing: it’s what people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase in and take off their hands.
Chasing after a sharp, high-volume surge is essentially providing liquidity for those who were already holding.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback happens on lower volume and prices stabilize,
you’ll get a better entry; if the price drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you a second bankroll.

About $6.6 million in Binance futures positions were liquidated over the past 4 hours. Long positions accounted for 60.4%, the largest share, at $ETH .
Guys, how should you interpret liquidation statistics? Here’s a quick explanation 👇
Maintenance margin is the minimum margin required to keep a position from being liquidated. Generally, the larger the position, the higher the required margin ratio.
Liquidation data can show which side has more concentrated leveraged funds, but it’s a record of what has already happened and can’t be used on its own to predict market direction.
The same data can mean very different things in different market conditions, so don’t blindly apply rules of thumb.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold On to a Losing Trade, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Notice that this thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the here and now.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you automatically seek out bullish news and tune out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “what would invalidate the logic behind this trade,”
then follow through when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

A $12.25 million ETH long, and in the end only $4,400 left in the account. This figure is all over the timeline today, but what it proves is exactly the opposite of most people’s first reaction after reading it: one account got wiped out, not the leverage structure.

First, let’s see whether the structure is in trouble. ETH is currently at 2,310.78, down 0.69% over 24 hours, with a trading volume of 6.253 billion USDT. Open interest in perpetual futures across the market is still at 5.463 billion USDT, and the 8-hour funding rate is +0.0044%, or about 4.8% annualized. If this were a genuine deleveraging event, open interest should drop sharply first, the funding rate should turn negative, and then the price should fall further. Right now, open interest hasn’t collapsed, the funding rate is still positive, and the price is drifting down on declining volume rather than plunging on heavy volume. None of these three indicators points to systemic liquidations. So Machi Big Brother’s position shrinking from $12.25 million to $4,400 was a total loss caused by position management—not a market signal.

Next, consider the scale of the funding rate. At +0.0044%, or 4.8% annualized, this is a “moderately positive funding rate” from a long trader’s perspective: people are willing to pay to hold positions, but there’s no eagerness to pay a premium. It’s more like a temperature reading telling us that nobody is rushing to buy. What’s truly dangerous isn’t a positive funding rate, but one so high that it eats up most of a long trader’s annual returns. At 4.8%, we’re not there yet. In other words, leverage itself isn’t expensive right now; what’s expensive is staying too long on the crowded side of the trade.

Is it crowded? Long accounts make up 77.4% of accounts. That’s a measure of the number of accounts, not position size. Viewed alongside 5.463 billion USDT in open interest, it suggests that the vast majority of those more-than-70% long accounts are small accounts with very light positions. A position on the scale of Machi Big Brother’s can disappear without leaving almost any trace in open interest. That’s what I meant earlier: the individual got wiped out; the structure didn’t budge.

So why is the price still drifting down? The clues are outside the market itself. Bitcoin is hovering around 80,400, ETFs have recorded $772 million in net outflows, oil prices are retreating, and the Fed decision is approaching. Risk appetite is contracting overall, and ETH, as a high-beta asset, is being dragged down along with it. This force is greater than any liquidation of a single whale. Blaming the decline on one person getting liquidated is the easiest explanation—and the least useful.

The risk lies elsewhere. With 77.4% of accounts long, positioning is very crowded by account count. If the price breaks below a key range, stop-losses among small accounts will trigger in a continuous, mechanical chain. Meanwhile, the 4.8% cost of holding longs is so low that it won’t force anyone to exit voluntarily. So when prices really fall, there may be no one-off capitulation to clear the market; instead, the decline can drag on slowly and painfully. In this kind of market, the people who get hurt most aren’t those who get the direction wrong, but those whose positions can’t survive long enough for the market to play out.

My short-term view leans toward repeated tests of the lower end of the range, rather than a one-way collapse. That’s based on the fact that neither of the structural indicators—open interest and funding rates—is showing signs of an imminent collapse, not on who got liquidated again. There’s only one real risk warning: first figure out how long your position can survive, then think about where ETH might go.

#ETH #Crypto

content:
1225万美元的ETH多头，最后账户里只剩4400美元。这个数字今天在广场刷屏，但它证明的事，和大多数人读完后的第一反应正好相反——爆掉的是一个账户，不是杠杆结构。

先看结构有没有事。ETH现价2310.78，24小时跌0.69%，成交额62.53亿USDT；全网合约持仓量还挂在54.63亿USDT，8小时资金费率报+0.0044%，折年约4.8%。如果这是一次真正的去杠杆，顺序应该是持仓量先明显缩水、费率转负、然后价格才补跌。现在持仓量没塌，费率还是正的，价格是缩量阴跌而不是放量砸盘。三条里没有一条指向系统性清算。所以麻吉大哥那1225万到4400美元，是一次仓位管理的全损，不是一个市场信号。

再看费率的量级。+0.0044%折年4.8%，这个数字放在多头视角是"温和正费率"——愿意付费持仓，但没有付出溢价的热情。它更像一个温度读数，告诉我们现在没人抢筹。真正危险的不是费率正，而是费率高到把多头一年收益吃掉大半；4.8%还没到那个程度。换句话说，杠杆本身现在不贵，贵的是在人多的一侧站太久。

人多不多？多头账户占比77.4%，这是人数口径，不是仓位口径。配合54.63亿USDT的持仓量一起看，说明这七成多的多头里，绝大多数是小账户，单仓很轻。麻吉大哥那种量级的仓位消失，在持仓量上几乎没留下痕迹。这就是我前面说的：死的是个体，结构没动。

那价格为什么还在阴跌？线索在盘面之外。比特币在80400附近，ETF端录得7.72亿美元净流出，油价回落，联储决议临近。风险偏好整体在收，ETH作为高beta资产被顺带压着走。这条线的力量，比任何一个巨鲸的清算都大。把下跌归因于某个人爆仓，是最省事也最没用的解释。

风险点在另一边。77.4%的多头账户意味着人数侧的拥挤度很高，一旦跌破关键区间，小额账户的止损是连续的、机械的；而4.8%的持多成本便宜到不会逼任何人主动下车，所以真跌的时候反而缺少一次性的投降式清洗，容易拖成慢跌磨人。这种行情最伤的不是方向判断错的人，是仓位撑不到行情走完的人。

短线我的判断偏区间下沿反复测试，而不是单边崩塌——依据是持仓量和费率这两个结构指标都没给出崩塌前兆，而不是谁又爆了仓。真正的风险提示只有一句：先算清楚你的仓位能活多久，再去想ETH会走到哪。

#ETH #Crypto

Let’s talk about transaction finality.
On chains that use Tendermint (CometBFT) consensus, such as Cosmos Hub, blocks are final as soon as they’re committed—there’s no need to wait for subsequent blocks.
One thing that’s easy to overlook: the number of confirmations an exchange requires for deposits is essentially the point at which the transaction has reached a level of finality the platform considers safe.
When depositing to or withdrawing from different chains, finality speeds vary from chain to chain, so a delayed arrival doesn’t necessarily mean something has gone wrong.

On Ethereum, the staked $ETH  is the guarantee of finality: rewriting a finalized block would result in the loss of a large amount of stake.

#ETH

content:
说说交易最终性。
基于 Tendermint（CometBFT）共识的链，比如 Cosmos Hub，区块一经提交就具有最终性，不需要再等后续区块。
容易被忽略的一点：交易所要求的入账确认数，本质上就是在等交易的最终性达到平台认为安全的程度。
在不同链之间充提，各条链的最终性速度不一样，到账慢未必是出了问题。
在以太坊上，质押的 $ETH 就是最终性的担保：改写已最终确定的区块要损失大量质押。

Before calling it a day | The night before the Fed meeting: double-check your overnight exposure

The Fed announces its rate decision tomorrow. Don’t let emotion take the reins of your positions tonight. The most common mistake retail traders make is turning “I want to know the outcome” into “I’ll add a little now and bet on the direction.”

Three things to check before holding overnight (writing them down is more useful than watching the market):
1) What’s the maximum overnight drawdown I can tolerate? If it’s exceeded, reduce my position to a size I can sleep with.
2) Are all my pending orders still valid? Have my stop-loss or take-profit orders been triggered or altered by this morning’s volatility?
3) Do I need to open any new positions before tomorrow’s market open? Most of the time, the answer is “no.”

The same goes for futures and spot: the advantage on Fed night isn’t guessing correctly—it’s staying in the game until the result is announced, then acting according to plan.

For informational purposes only, not investment advice. Which line will you write down first tonight?

translatedData.content:
#bitmine增持10452枚eth 
There’s not much to get excited about, let alone thrilled. The amount of money itself isn’t that big. What’s really worth noting is that they also did something much bigger at the same time. 👍

The company announced on October 26 that, as of October 25, its Ethereum holdings had reached 6,051,933 ETH. Using their own figure of $2,356 per ETH, those coins alone are worth about $14.3 billion. Add cash, stocks, and other investments, and the total comes to around $15 billion. The previous week it was still $15.1 billion. They added coins, but the value on the books actually shrank.

10,452 ETH, worth about $24 million. Against the more than 6 million coins they hold, that’s not even a drop in the bucket. They bought 12,535 ETH last week, so this week’s purchase was smaller. It looks like a lot, but in reality they’ve slowed down their buying.

The bigger move this week was buying back their own shares: about 2.04 million shares at an average price of $22.48, for nearly $46 million. Buybacks this year have now reached about $400 million. Cash fell from $582 million to $514 million, a decrease of about $68 million. They spent $24 million on coins and $46 million on buybacks—together, that roughly accounts for the cash reduction this week.

So this isn’t a case of going all-in because they’re bullish. It’s more like a company that already holds too many coins realizing its own stock is cheaper than the coins, so it’s looking after its shareholders first. They’re still buying coins, mainly to see through that slogan. They want to own 5% of the Ethereum supply; they’re now at 4.95%, with about 58,000 ETH to go. They call it “5% Alchemy.” That final stretch is worth more as a narrative than the 10,452 ETH themselves.

There’s another thing many people haven’t factored in. They’ve staked about 5.22 million ETH, roughly 86% of their holdings. At their assumed yield, staking generates about $300 million a year. These aren’t spot coins they can just dump tomorrow. Even if the price moves sideways or falls, their holdings are still paying them. You’re sitting on spot ETH, waiting it out; they’re earning yield on the very same coins. Those are completely different mindsets.

They also didn’t say whether they bought these coins on an exchange or in a private deal, let alone disclose the average purchase price. So take the claim that “exchanges saw 10,452 ETH of buying this week” with a grain of salt.
The hardest moments for retail investors are times like this. A news story comes out and it feels like someone has proved you were right about the direction. But they’re buying toward a public target, buying into their own stock story, and buying a long-term position they can stake. Get it? 🥳🥳
#ETH

      公司10月26日公布，截至10月25日，以太坊库存到了6051933枚。按他们自己用的2356美元算，光这些币大约143亿美元。加上现金、股票和其他投资，总账大约150亿美元。上一周还是151亿。币加了，账面反而缩了。

           10452枚，大约2400万美元。对他们手里那600多万枚来说，连零头都算不上。上周他们还买了12535枚，这周更少。看起来很满，账上其实是买慢了。

 这周更重的一笔，是回头买自己的股票。大约204万股，均价22.48美元，花了将近4600万美元。今年回购已经到了大约4亿美元。现金从5.82亿降到5.14亿，少了大约6800万。买币2400万，回购4600万，两边加起来，差不多把这周少掉的现金对上了。

       所以这不是看涨就全押进去。更像一家已经拿了太多币的公司，发现自家股价比币更便宜，就先踏马照顾股东。币还在买，主要是为了把那句口号走完。他们要拿下以太坊供应量的5%，现在4.95%，还差大约5.8万枚。名字叫什么5%炼金术。最后这一点，叙事价值比这10452枚本身大。

title: ETH跌到2300关口，多空都在等一个答案
subTitle:
ETH又回到了熟悉的位置：2300美元附近。10月26日一度跌到2295，今天最低2302，整个10月累计跌了13%左右——可能是以太坊8年来最差的一个10月。ETH/BTC的汇率趴在0.03，几乎是历史低位区间。这个位置很关键，多空都在等一个答案。

◆ 资金面：机构在撤，基金会也在动

最扎眼的是ETF。10月26日美国现货以太坊ETF单日净流出8860万美元，贝莱德的ETHA领跌；10月中旬那一周更是净流出3.2亿美元，赎回强度是同口径BTC ETF的十倍——要知道ETH ETF的盘子只有BTC的七分之一。机构资金不是小幅调整，是在系统性降仓位。

链上也不平静。以太坊基金会关联钱包刚被监测到向Kraken转出约1100万美元的ETH，这个信号很敏感：基金会卖币从来都会被市场放大解读。更早还有Arthur Hayes清仓部分ETH，加上短期持有者割肉离场，供应端压力一波接一波。

◆ 技术面：2300守不守得住

看K线，2300是过去两周反复测试的多空分界线：30天最低2286.6，7天最低2286.6，今天又压到2302。下方一旦破位，下一站看2280附近，再往下就是2200整数关。上方压力先看2333到2343（昨天高点），突破之后2500才是真正的心理大关。Hyperliquid上现在还挂着2.52亿美元的ETH空单，空头明显在压阵。

◆ 事件面：Glamsterdam升级一路坎坷

原本被寄予厚望的Glamsterdam升级，过去一周堪称多灾多难：先是被推迟，然后开发者又修复了一个质押存款记账漏洞（可能让运营者把验证者存款记到自己名下），修复方案周一才合并。好消息是漏洞没有实际利用、没有损失，坏消息是升级节奏拖了，市场对以太坊的叙事耐心在消耗。

◆ 宏观面：美联储周三给答案

本周三美联储议息，市场普遍预期维持4%利率不动，但担心措辞偏鹰；欧洲央行、日本央行本周也开议息会，全球流动性预期整体偏紧。这种环境下，ETH这种高Beta资产首当其冲——美股AI反弹救不了它，油价回落也帮不上忙。

◆ 我的看法

短期看，ETH现在是被资金面和情绪面双重压制，方向要等两个信号：一是美联储会不会松口，二是ETH ETF资金流能不能转正。技术上2300一旦失守，下探2280甚至2200的概率不小；反过来，如果能站稳2300并重新收回2333上方，才算给出企稳信号。

中长期没那么悲观：质押收益还在，Glamsterdam落地后的供应逻辑还在，ETH/BTC这个位置历史上往往对应以太坊的相对底部区间。但说句实话，在真正的大规模山寨行情启动之前，ETH很难独自走强——它现在更像是在等比特币先站稳，再等山寨季把自己带起来。

ETH has returned to a familiar level: around $2,300. It briefly fell to 2,295 on October 26, and today’s low was 2,302. For the whole of October, it has fallen about 13% — possibly Ethereum’s worst October in eight years. The ETH/BTC ratio is languishing at 0.03, almost in the historical low range. This level is critical, and both bulls and bears are waiting for an answer.

◆ Capital flows: institutions are pulling out, and the foundation is also making moves

The most eye-catching thing is the ETF. On October 26, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs saw a single-day net outflow of $88.6 million, with BlackRock’s ETHA leading the declines; in the week in mid-October, net outflows were even larger at $320 million, and the redemption intensity was ten times that of BTC ETFs on the same basis — keep in mind that the ETH ETF market is only one-seventh the size of BTC’s. Institutional money is not making a small adjustment; it is systematically cutting positions.

🚨 The Golden Rule of Crypto Cycles: Are You Watching the Right Indicators? 🚨

Most traders lose money in crypto not because they pick bad projects, but because they misunderstand the market cycle. If you want to stay ahead of the crowd, you need to understand the flow of liquidity. 

Keep a close eye on Bitcoin Dominance (BTC.D). Here is how the crypto money cycle historically flows:

1️⃣ The Bitcoin Phase: Institutional and smart money flows into $BTC first. Bitcoin leads the market rally, while most altcoins bleed or stay flat against it. 
2️⃣ The Ethereum Phase: Profits from Bitcoin start rotating into $ETH. Ethereum begins to break out, which is the first major signal that market risk appetite is expanding. 
3️⃣ The Large-Cap Rotation: Once Ethereum runs, liquidity trickles down into high-conviction large caps like $SOL and $BNB. 
4️⃣ Altcoin Season: Finally, money floods into mid-caps and micro-caps. This is the euphoric phase where the massive multiples happen.

💡 The Biggest Mistake: Buying highly volatile, small-cap altcoins during Phase 1 when Bitcoin is sucking up all the market liquidity. 
💡 The Fix: Follow the money. Respect the king first, then look for altcoin setups as dominance peaks and liquidity rotates.

translatedData.content:
One more fix before the Ethereum upgrade: staking deposits must stop landing in the “wrong account.”

According to reports by CoinDesk, PANews, good.box, and others, developers have fixed a deposit-processing bug in the upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade. In a specific scenario where a public key is shared, the original rules could credit ETH intended by a staking service for creating a new validator to a builder’s balance instead. The operator could then withdraw the funds, while the validator would fail to be created. The fix was merged into the consensus specifications on Monday: pending deposits will be classified by withdrawal credentials, so validator deposits will still be credited to the validator even when they share a public key with a builder. The upgrade has already been activated on Sepolia. The Hoodi activation, originally scheduled for October 26, has been postponed; the mainnet date is still undecided, and clients still need to incorporate the new rule.

How to read this: This is a specification patch along the upgrade path, not evidence that funds are being stolen on mainnet. It’s more useful to track client adoption, the new Hoodi schedule, and deposit validation by staking protocols themselves. For most people, the practical takeaway is to follow official testnet announcements rather than treating “bug fix” as a bearish price headline.

#以太坊 #ETH #Glamsterdam #StakingSecurity

content:
以太坊升级前又补了一刀：质押存款别再「走错户头」。

据 CoinDesk / PANews / good.box 等转述：开发者修复了即将到来的 Glamsterdam 升级中一处存款处理漏洞——在特定公钥共用场景下，原规则可能把质押服务本用于新建验证者的 ETH 记到构建者（builder）余额，运营者有机会提走资金且验证者无法创建。修复已于周一并入共识规范：待处理存款按提款凭证分类，验证者存款即使与构建者共用公钥也仍归验证者侧。Sepolia 此前已激活该升级；原定 10 月 26 日的 Hoodi 激活已推迟，主网日期仍待定，客户端还需合入新规则。

怎么读：这是升级路径上的规范修补，不是主网已在被盗。更值得对照客户端合入进度、Hoodi 新日程，以及质押协议自身的存款校验。对普通人更实用的是：关注官方测试网公告，而不是把「漏洞修复」当成价格利空标题。

translatedData.subTitle:
Many people hesitate to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
can’t take it. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you buy in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I’ve ever met cuts his losses more decisively than anyone. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金

Eth fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders

Eth developers have patched a flaw in the upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade that could have let someone walk off with eth that staking services meant for new validators

The fix, which changed the rules for handling validator deposits, was merged Monday, a week after developers turned it down

Glamsterdam splits up two jobs that are bundled together today. Builders put blocks of transactions together, and validators, who stake eth to help secure the network, pick and confirm them. Both can deposit ETH, and their money is supposed to be tracked separately
How the money could go missing
The problem appeared during the upgrade itself, when Eth would process deposits that were still waiting to be credited
Researcher avsetsin identified a scenario in which an operator first registers as a builder using a particular public key, the identifier tied to a validator or builder. If a staking service then deposits eth to start a validator under that key, the draft rules would credit both deposits to the builder.

“The operator can withdraw the protocol’s funds,” avsetsin wrote. No validator gets created, so the staking service can’t produce the proof it would need to recover its money.

Avsetsin, who is listed as a member of Lido’s GitHub organization, looked at how Lido, Origin and Rocket Pool could be affected, in what the researcher called “quick AI research.” The findings depended on how each protocol handles deposits

“These are conditional code findings, not confirmed live exploits,” avsetsin wrote, adding that existing checks rejecting an earlier builder deposit could stop the attack. No losses have been reported

Turned down, then merged
Developers closed the proposed fix on Oct. 19. “There was not enough support from clients to make this change at this time,” wrote Justin Traglia, who maintains Eth consensus specifications. Clients are the separate software programs validators run to take part in the network.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Positions: Fortune in the Face of Risk, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【How Rolling Positions Works】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to trade on leverage. As long as the trend continues, the compounding can be staggering; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
a gain of several dozen points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Math】The essence of rolling positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting four wins in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve correctly read the trend and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all in right away and adding to your full position with unrealized profits is a recipe for ending up on the liquidation list.
A common sight. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. This keeps your average cost weighted toward lower levels, so you can handle a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, then adding more and more as the price rises) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn a profit into a loss. Once you lose your nerve, your whole trading plan falls apart.

title: 欧洲客户先用上了：Kraken把$BTC期权塞进同一账户
subTitle:
不是又开一个合约页面那么简单。

10月26日 Kraken 官方博客：符合条件的欧洲经济区（EEA）客户，可在 Kraken Pro 用现有衍生品账户交易 $BTC（XBT/USD）和 $ETH（ETH/USD）期权；网页和 App 都行，和期货共用抵押品，组合保证金默认打开。

产品形态写得很清楚：欧式、美元现金交割、线性结算——权利金、盈亏、到期结算都走美元。到期档有周、月、季、半年。下单走询价（RFQ），一笔最多五腿；接受报价即成交。开通前要过适当性问卷。期权本身没有资金费率，同账户里的永续合约仍会计费。

牌照侧：投资服务由塞浦路斯实体 PEDSL-CY（CySEC 牌照 342/17）提供；数字资产托管仍归 MiCA 托管方 PESL。这跟母公司 Payward 想在 Hyperliquid HIP-3 上做「待批」的美国监管永续是两条线——这边是欧洲期权已上线，那边还在等批。

筛选一句：欧洲监管账户里，$BTC/$ETH 期权从「预告」变成「能询价」。不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: European clients get first access: Kraken adds $BTC options to the same account
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s not as simple as just opening another contract page.

October 26, Kraken’s official blog: Eligible clients in the European Economic Area (EEA) can trade $BTC (XBT/USD) and $ETH (ETH/USD) options on Kraken Pro using their existing derivatives account. Trading is available on both the web and app; options share collateral with futures, and portfolio margin is enabled by default.

The product structure is clearly laid out: European-style, cash-settled in USD, and linear settlement—all premiums, P&L, and expiry settlements are in USD. Expiries are available weekly, monthly, quarterly, and semiannually. Orders are placed through RFQ, with up to five legs per trade; accepting a quote executes the trade. You must pass a suitability questionnaire before enabling trading. Options themselves have no funding rate, though perpetual contracts in the same account still incur funding fees.

However, this metric alone makes it difficult to determine the long-term trend. Similar situations have occurred many times in the past, but the market ultimately took different paths. title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Risk Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
shouldn’t exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means a maximum loss of 200 U per trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34%. You’d need to nearly double your money to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much out of the game.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

To see how large traders are betting, many people look at the long/short ratio. But the two calculation methods measure completely different things.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scale Out to Take Profits: How to Lock in Gains While Letting Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses: cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking strategy I always use.

【Three stages】Stage one: at the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third and lock in some profit,
At this point, the trade is already risk-free, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage two: at the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), take another third off. Stage three: trail the stop on the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you close the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you'll often watch your gains disappear and end up back where you started.

A protocol changes its contract logic overnight—could the coins users have deposited be affected?
First, what this means: During an upgrade, an account with upgrade privileges changes the proxy contract to point to a new logic contract. The address users interact with stays the same, but the logic being executed is replaced.
The underlying risk: If upgrade privileges are controlled by just one private key and that key is stolen, an attacker can upgrade the contract to malicious logic.

If you’re supporting your family by trading crypto, save these eight golden rules!

Eight years of hands-on experience in crypto, from losses to profits, distilled into these eight golden rules. They’ve helped me avoid every major crash and land safely every time! I’m sharing them today for those who understand. Get them right, and you’ll avoid detours and losses of millions!

1. Don’t rely only on the daily chart for short-term entries: When trading short-term, don’t just watch the daily crypto chart. Check the 30-minute chart too, and wait for the broader market to stabilize and move in sync before entering.

Sometimes you see a candlestick with a long upper wick and think the opportunity has passed, only for a big bullish candle—or even a limit-up move—the next day. The 30-minute chart can give you an early clue.

2. If the trend and market structure are wrong, don’t blindly follow: When the trend and market structure aren’t right, even taking one more look can lead to a mistake. Go with the trend, and make sure the structure of the uptrend remains intact.

3. If it’s not a short-term hot sector, don’t bother: If a short-term trade isn’t in a hot sector or one with the potential to heat up, it’s better not to trade it.

4. Set aside impulse; trade with a plan: Give up the urge to jump into a trade impulsively. “Trade your plan, and plan your trade.”

5. Treat others’ opinions as reference; your own analysis matters most: Anyone’s views or opinions are just a reference. Think deeply and do your own careful analysis.

6. Choose your direction before picking a coin: First identify the broad direction, then carefully select individual coins. Get the direction right, and you’ll achieve more with less effort; get it wrong, and you’ll have to work twice as hard for half the result.

7. Enter coins that are already rising: Trying to guess the bottom is a major mistake. Don’t keep imagining an imminent rebound or a final shakeout. Prices tend to move toward the path of least resistance, so entering a coin that’s already rising means choosing the direction with less resistance.

8. After a big win or loss, step aside and review: After a big win or loss, stay out of the market for a while and reassess both the charts and yourself. Once you’ve figured out why it happened, trade again. Years of experience show that this approach works more than 90% of the time.

Akash officially selects Solana, AKT to become a native token

Akash, a decentralized computing-power marketplace, has officially selected Solana as its migration destination. The project has long operated its own chain based on the Cosmos SDK, specializing in decentralized GPU and AI computing-power rentals. In October 2025, founder Greg Osuri publicly said that the project was considering a move to Solana, but no decision had been made at the time, and other options, including the Ethereum ecosystem, were still under evaluation. On October 26, 2026, Akash published a detailed announcement saying that its core team had selected the Solana mainnet: it will leave its Cosmos chain and rebuild its computing-power marketplace as a native Solana program, with AKT becoming a native Solana token.
The official document outlines three key details. First, the migration will not happen immediately: no transition date has been set, and the switch will require independent audits and migration rehearsals to be completed, followed by a separate governance vote. After the switch, existing workloads will continue running for 90 days to give tenants time to redeploy. Second, AKT comes first: after the migration proposal passes and both audits are approved, the team will launch an AKT SPL token on Solana within two weeks and open a one-way migration portal for two years. Third, the process includes fallback conditions: if major exchanges do not support the Token-2022 standard, or if the consensus upgrade proves unstable, the project may still switch to an EVM-based path.
The rationale can be broken down into four points. First, there is no longer a need to pay for a chain the project does not use: around 100 validators stake AKT solely to maintain consensus, while the core team also has to maintain forks of components such as cosmos-sdk. After the migration, Solana will provide security, and the network’s daily fees will be about 0.075 SOL—only a few dollars. Second, scaling will come at near-zero cost: the median cost per Solana transaction is about $0.001, and Akash handles around 15,000 marketplace transactions a day, a light load even if scaled up a hundredfold. Third, DePIN projects have already clustered on Solana, with Helium, Render, io.net, and Nosana all settling transactions there; the migrations of Helium and Render offer precedents. Fourth, liquidity and users: Solana leads in weekly DEX trading volume, has about $15 billion in stablecoins, and sees roughly 2.2 million daily fee-paying addresses. By contrast, the Cosmos ecosystem is contracting, and Noble, a stablecoin-focused chain, left in March 2026. The trade-offs are also explicit: giving up sovereign consensus, validator revenue, native IBC, and the narrative of operating its own chain.
The potential impact should be separated into facts and speculation. As a matter of fact, AKT will become a native Solana token, and Solana’s DePIN landscape will gain a computing-power rental protocol. Speculatively, if the migration proceeds smoothly, Solana’s clustering effect around DePIN and AI computing-power narratives may strengthen further, while some AKT currently staked with validators may shift toward liquidity and ecosystem incentives. The appeal of the Cosmos app-chain model may also come under scrutiny as a prominent project moves away. These are speculations and depend on how the migration is carried out.
Editor's note: This is a trade-off that puts performance, cost, and ecosystem density ahead of a sovereignty narrative. The decision is public and includes fallback conditions, offering a relatively high degree of transparency. The key things to watch next are the timing of the governance vote, the results of the two audits, and the details of the two-year migration window—not the short-term sentiment triggered by a single announcement.

去中心化算力租赁网络Akash已正式选定Solana作为迁移目标。项目长期基于Cosmos SDK运行独立链，主打去中心化GPU与AI算力租赁。早在2025年10月，创始人Greg Osuri曾公开表示考虑迁移至Solana，但当时未定，仍在评估以太坊生态等其他选项。2026年10月26日，Akash发布长文，宣布核心团队选定Solana主网：离开自有Cosmos链，把算力市场重构为Solana原生程序，AKT将转为Solana原生代币。
官方文件给出三项关键细节。其一，迁移并非立即执行：切换日期未定，须待独立审计与迁移演练通过后，由单独的治理投票决定；切换后现有工作负载继续运行90天，供租户重新部署。其二，AKT先行：迁移提案通过且两份审计过关后，团队将于两周内在Solana上线AKT的SPL代币，并开放为期两年的单向迁移门户。其三，流程设有回退条件：若头部交易所不支持Token-2022标准，或共识升级出现不稳定，仍可能转向EVM路径。
决策理由可拆为四点。第一，不再为用不到的链付费：约100名验证人质押AKT仅用于维护共识，核心团队还需维护cosmos-sdk等组件分叉；迁移后安全由Solana继承，全网日费用约0.075 SOL，仅几美元量级。第二，近零成本扩容：Solana单笔交易中位成本约0.001美元，Akash每日约1.5万笔市场交易，即便放大百倍仍属轻量。第三，DePIN项目已在Solana聚集，Helium、Render、io.net、Nosana等均在其上结算，Helium与Render的迁链先例提供了参照。第四，流动性与用户：Solana周度DEX交易量居首，稳定币约150亿美元，日付费地址约220万；反观Cosmos生态收缩，稳定币链Noble已于2026年3月离开。代价亦被明示：放弃主权共识、验证人收入、原生IBC与自有链叙事。

编辑观察：这是一次把性能、成本与生态密度置于主权叙事之上的取舍，决策公开、留有回退条件，透明度较高。后续看点在于治理投票节奏、两份审计结果与两年迁移窗口的执行细节，而非单次公告带来的短期情绪。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place a Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop could end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Adjust your position size accordingly: if the stop distance is large, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on a single trade is still a percentage of your capital.

📰 Why are SoFi’s tokenized deposits putting banks and stablecoins on a direct collision course?

After SoFi launched its tokenized deposit service, the CEO of Truth Ventures went off: banks now have a new weapon to take on stablecoins. In simple terms, customers deposit money at a bank, and the bank issues them a token as proof of the deposit—which can also be traded on the secondary market. Now banks won’t just offer regular deposits; they’ll also have crypto-like features and can compete directly with stablecoins like UST and DAI. That also raises questions about regulation and user protection.

Why does this news matter?
The core of this story is that “banks have learned how to play the crypto game.” Banks and crypto used to be two separate worlds, but now banks are adopting the tokenization model behind stablecoins. This reflects banks’ ambition to tap into DeFi’s deep pools of money. More fundamentally, though, it brings the potential threat of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) into sharper focus: if banks can do it, might governments find it even easier? This means the boundary between crypto and traditional finance is becoming even more blurred. Regulators will either have to quickly fill in the rulebook or watch banks eat into stablecoins’ market share.

Market impact
The direct impact is clear: if bank tokenized deposits catch on, they could draw users away from stablecoins. For BTC and ETH, sentiment could get a short-term boost—after all, financial innovation in crypto is better than nothing. But looking at the medium-term trend, if banks can truly build competitive tokenized products, they could indeed weaken demand for some stablecoins. Historical comparisons are hard to come by, but one similar event was when traditional funds started offering Bitcoin ETFs in 2022, ultimately helping push BTC from around $30,000 to $60,000. The competitive effects sparked by this wave of innovation could be even more intense than those of ETFs.

How to approach it
I see this as a positive signal for financial innovation in crypto, showing that traditional finance is embracing crypto principles at an accelerating pace. If banks can really bring product costs below those of stablecoin protocols, they could indeed draw away some demand. But in the short term, this is more of a catalyst; it’s unlikely to push BTC or ETH directly into a new phase. If bank tokenized products suffer widespread defaults or face a regulatory crackdown, this thesis no longer holds.

📰 为什么SoFi的代币化存款要让银行和稳定币直接开战？

SoFi推出代币化存款服务后，Truth Ventures CEO直接炸锅：这下银行有新武器直接跟稳定币掐架了。简单说，就是用户的钱存银行，银行给个代币凭证，这个凭证还能在二级市场交易。这下银行不光有普通存款，还能有加密属性，直接跟UST、DAI这些稳定币抢饭碗，监管和用户保护问题也跟着来了。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这事儿的核心是"银行学会了加密的玩法"。过去银行和加密是两拨人，现在银行直接把稳定币的代币化逻辑拿过来用。这背后是银行想抓住DeFi大钱袋的野心，但更深层是央行数字货币（CBDC）的潜在威胁在提前显现——如果银行能做，那政府做起来会不会更顺手？意味着加密和传统金融的界限被进一步模糊，监管要么得赶紧补规则，要么就得眼睁睁看银行蚕食稳定币生存空间。

对市场的影响
直接影响链路很清晰：银行代币化存款一旦流行，会分流稳定币用户。对BTC/ETH来说，短期情绪可能被刺激——毕竟这是加密的金融创新，总比没劲好。但中期趋势看，如果银行真能做出有竞争力的代币化产品，那确实会削弱部分稳定币需求。历史参考有点难找，但类似事件有2022年传统基金开始做比特币ETF，最终导致BTC价格从$3万附近被顶到$6万，这波创新引发的竞争效应可能比ETF更猛烈。

操作思路
我认为这是利好加密货币的金融创新信号，意味着传统金融正在加速拥抱加密逻辑。如果银行真能把产品成本压到低于稳定币协议，那确实会分流部分需求。但短期内这更像是催化剂，直接推BTC或ETH到新阶段可能性不大。如果出现银行代币化产品大规模违约或监管突袭，这个逻辑作废。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

[State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive] This means longs are crowded, and everyone is borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often in the acceleration phase of a push toward the top, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. This doesn’t mean you should immediately
short, but rather: be especially cautious about chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past started at moments like this.
